column1: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.audit_logs (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, action text NOT NULL, resource_type text NOT NULL, ip_address text, metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.audit_maturity_scores (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), audit_id uuid NOT NULL, pillar_name text NOT NULL, maturity_score numeric NOT NULL, recommendations text, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.audit_reports (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), audit_id uuid NOT NULL, version integer DEFAULT 1, status text DEFAULT 'draft'::text, executive_summary text, ai_readiness_assessment jsonb, capability_scores jsonb, opportunity_matrix jsonb, top_use_cases jsonb, quick_wins_strategic_bets jsonb, roadmap jsonb, roi_estimates jsonb, solution_blueprints jsonb, proposal_draft text, generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), last_edited_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), finalized_at timestamp with time zone, created_by uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), report_payload text, plan_tier text DEFAULT 'foundation'::text);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.audits (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, title text NOT NULL, conducted_by uuid, conducted_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), status text DEFAULT 'draft'::text, notes text, raw_responses jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, overall_maturity_score numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.grant_applications (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), org_name text NOT NULL, registration_type text NOT NULL, hq_location text NOT NULL, mission_statement text NOT NULL, problem_solved text NOT NULL, tech_bottleneck text NOT NULL, leadership_confirmed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, grant_use_case text NOT NULL, amplification_pledged boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, media_reach_link text, deck_url text, contact_name text NOT NULL, contact_title text NOT NULL, contact_email text NOT NULL, contact_phone text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text, grant_cohort text DEFAULT '2026-Q1'::text, rubric_impact_score integer DEFAULT 0, rubric_complexity_score integer DEFAULT 0, rubric_leadership_score integer DEFAULT 0, rubric_amplification_score integer DEFAULT 0, rubric_total_weighted integer DEFAULT 0, internal_notes text, signed_agreement_url text, reviewed_by uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.partner_audit_logs (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), entity_type character varying(50) NOT NULL, entity_id uuid NOT NULL, action character varying(100) NOT NULL, details jsonb, performed_by character varying(255) DEFAULT 'system'::character varying, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.partner_commissions (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), deal_id uuid NOT NULL, partner_id uuid NOT NULL, commission_type character varying(50) DEFAULT 'year_1_30pct'::character varying, deal_revenue_inr numeric NOT NULL, commission_rate numeric NOT NULL, commission_amount_inr numeric NOT NULL, payout_status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'calculated'::character varying, invoice_number character varying(100), paid_at timestamp with time zone, payment_reference character varying(255), created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.partner_deals (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), partner_id uuid NOT NULL, target_company_name character varying(255) NOT NULL, target_domain character varying(255) NOT NULL, contact_person_name character varying(255) NOT NULL, contact_email character varying(255) NOT NULL, contact_phone character varying(50), package_tier character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Nisol Enterprise'::character varying, estimated_deal_value_inr numeric DEFAULT 1850000.00, status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'protected'::character varying, conflict_partner_id uuid, protection_starts_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), protection_expires_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() + '90 days'::interval), sla_response_due_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() + '48:00:00'::interval), sla_contacted_at timestamp with time zone, notes text, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.partners (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), user_id uuid, full_name character varying(255) NOT NULL, work_email character varying(255) NOT NULL, company_name character varying(255) NOT NULL, phone character varying(50), website character varying(255), partner_track character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Implementation Partner (25-35%)'::character varying, primary_market character varying(100) DEFAULT 'India Tier-1 Cities'::character varying, estimated_referrals character varying(100), is_founding_partner boolean DEFAULT false, commission_rate_yr1 numeric DEFAULT 0.30, commission_rate_yr2 numeric DEFAULT 0.20, unique_ref_code character varying(50) NOT NULL, status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'pending_approval'::character varying, priority_territory character varying(255), created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (id uuid NOT NULL, tenant_id uuid, full_name text, role USER-DEFINED NOT NULL DEFAULT 'client'::user_role, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.questions (id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('questions_id_seq'::regclass), section text NOT NULL, order_index integer NOT NULL, question_text text NOT NULL, tip_discussion text, triggered_patterns ARRAY, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), "IsActive" boolean DEFAULT true, updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.report_templates (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, description text, sections jsonb, styling jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.revenue_range_defaults (range_label text NOT NULL, mid_point_cr numeric, min_cr numeric, max_cr numeric);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.solution_blueprints (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, description text, category text, technology_stack ARRAY, architecture_diagram text, implementation_steps ARRAY, estimated_timeline text, resource_requirements text, success_metrics ARRAY, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.tenants (id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, industry text, employee_count integer, revenue_range text, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), website text, tenant_type text DEFAULT 'client'::text, sub_industry text, industry_sector text, country text, state text, city text, status text DEFAULT 'active'::text, joined_date date, created_by uuid, updated_by uuid, company_size text, tenant_secure text, company_hash text, website_hash text, pricing_plan text DEFAULT 'foundation'::text, partner_id uuid, partner_name character varying(255));
